verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector/search database. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform axis rather than a capability buyers would expect of this product type. The evidence's collection forking ('Dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll-outs') and point-in-time recovery apply to data, not automations, so they are adjacent features and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
